column4: Visit note | 2025-11-18 02:00 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Manik Saha, 53, male. Mr. Saha says he has itchy dry patches on the elbows and knees and finds himself scratching at night. He works as a graphic designer, and his symptoms started after working with cleaning chemicals in Khulna. He denies any relevant negative symptoms of fever, joint swelling, or widespread rashes. On examination: affected area about 3 cm across, BP 134/84 mmHg, pulse 89 bpm, weight 91 kg. Skin shows dry, lichenified plaques over extensor surfaces with mild excoriation. Assessment: Atopic eczema. Plan: lifestyle and self-care advice only; no new medicine was prescribed today. He was advised to use a mild soap, avoid hot baths, and wear cotton clothes. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-11-19 11:00 AM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Saiful Dewan, 62, male. Mr. Dewan reports that his symptoms are worse at night, accompanied by numbness in the toes and a burning sensation in both feet. He works as a bus driver, and these troubles started after years of high sugar found at a health camp in Shyamoli. He denies any recent foot ulcers, unsteadiness of gait, or visual disturbances. On examination: reduced sensation at 8 of 10 monofilament test sites, BP 121/81 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 49 kg. Neurological evaluation reveals diminished ankle reflexes bilaterally. Assessment: Peripheral neuropathy. Plan: tests ordered before starting treatment, including HbA1c, vitamin B12, and a nerve conduction study; no new medicine was prescribed today. He was advised to check the feet daily for cuts, wear soft closed shoes, and keep blood sugar under control. Follow-up after the test results are ready.

Visit note | 2025-11-20 04:30 PM | Dr. Saiful Alam, Endocrinology | Patient: Orin Kabir, 41, female. Mrs. Kabir complains of aching bones and muscle cramps. She works as a fisherman, and she noticed these aches after working in a windowless office in Rangpur. She denies any severe joint deformities, muscle weakness, or recent trauma. On examination: vitamin D level 10 ng/mL, BP 125/79 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 62 kg. Musculoskeletal examination shows generalized tenderness without joint swelling. Assessment: Vitamin D deficiency. Plan: lifestyle and self-care advice only; no new medicine was prescribed today. She was advised to get 20 minutes of morning sunlight daily and eat eggs and fish. Follow-up in 3 months with a repeat vitamin D level.

Visit note | 2025-11-22 12:30 PM | Dr. Rokeya Khatun, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Mala Bose, 28, female. Ms. Bose presents with complaints of extra hair on the face, irregular periods, and progressive weight gain. She works as a graphic designer, and she first noticed these changes after a friend in Sylhet suggested testing. She has a history of Bronchial asthma. She denies any visual changes, severe pelvic pain, or rapid hair loss. On examination: BMI 25.2, BP 122/79 mmHg, pulse 84 bpm, weight 56 kg. Abdominal examination is unremarkable with no palpable masses. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: tests ordered before starting treatment, specifically a pelvic ultrasound and hormone profile; no new medicine was prescribed today. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up after the test results are ready.

Visit note | 2025-11-22 03:30 PM | Dr. Moinul Haque, Neurology | Patient: Lamia Munshi, 46, female. Mrs. Munshi states that bright light hurts her eyes and she frequently experiences nausea alongside her head pain. She works as a hotel receptionist, and her discomfort has been worse since bright screens were introduced at a new job in Mirpur. She denies any focal neurological deficits, fever, or head trauma. On examination: about 10 headache days a month, BP 118/79 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 64 kg. Cranial nerve examination is normal. Assessment: Migraine. Plan: tests ordered before starting treatment: no tests; no new medicine was prescribed today. She was advised to keep a headache diary, sleep and eat at regular times, and limit screen time. Follow-up after the test results are ready.

Visit note | 2025-11-25 10:00 AM | Dr. Habibur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Ashraf Sheikh, 70, male. Mr. Sheikh describes a creaking knee, knee pain when using the stairs, and stiffness in the morning that lasts for a few minutes. He works as a tailor, and his pain became worse after a long sightseeing trip on foot in Motijheel. He denies any locking, sudden giving way, or night pain. On examination: BMI 31.8, BP 117/80 mmHg, pulse 77 bpm, weight 91 kg. Range of motion in both knees is slightly restricted with crepitus on flexion. Assessment: Knee osteoarthritis. Plan: lifestyle and self-care advice only; no new medicine was prescribed today. He was advised to do thigh-strengthening exercises daily, lose weight, and avoid squatting and sitting cross-legged on the floor. Follow-up in 6 weeks with physiotherapy.

Visit note | 2025-11-25 02:30 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Tamim Siddique, 57, male. Mr. Siddique mentions that his symptoms are worse in winter, featuring itchy dry patches on the elbows and knees and constant scratching at night. He works as a shopkeeper, and his condition started after working with cleaning chemicals in Narayanganj. He denies any systemic symptoms like fever or weight loss. On examination: affected area about 5 cm across, BP 124/86 mmHg, pulse 77 bpm, weight 44 kg. Skin assessment shows erythematous scaly plaques over the extensor joints. Assessment: Atopic eczema. Plan: referral to Endocrinology in this clinic for further assessment; no new medicine was prescribed today. He was advised to use a mild soap, avoid hot baths, and wear cotton clothes. Follow-up after the Endocrinology review.
